title: Ariel School witnesses reunite in Los Angeles

tellings.quote: they all just agreed for the first time ever to get back together after 20 years of the case The Landing case in Ru Zimbabwe

plain: Witnesses to the Ariel School case, a reported landing of a craft near a school in Ruwa, Zimbabwe, agreed to meet again for the first time, 20 years later, in Los Angeles. A UFO filmmaker and investigator named James Fox tells Michels about it as someone who was involved in bringing them together. A reunion like this matters because the witnesses could compare their memories of the event as adults.
